title: Verilay KYC Credential v3
description: Credential asserting that Verilay's KYC provider approved the subject, together with the minimal attributes needed for on-chain policy queries and the subject's verified full name, so the person can see what a disclosure statement would share. Merklized: no iden3_serialization directive, every subject field is addressable through the merklization root.

kycApproved.title: KYC Approved
kycApproved.description: True when the KYC provider returned an approved decision for this subject.

documentCountry.title: Document Country
documentCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the identity document used for KYC, e.g. "DEU". Optional: the KYC provider does not always return a country, and no policy queries it. An absent value is simply not in the merklization tree.

birthday.title: Birthday
birthday.description: Date of birth encoded as the integer YYYYMMDD, e.g. 19970517 for 1997-05-17. Integer encoding is what makes age comparisons expressible as an on-chain range query.

fullName.title: Full Name
fullName.description: The subject's full legal name as verified by the KYC provider from the identity document, as a single display string, e.g. "Jane Doe". Carried so the person can see in their vault exactly what an issuer-attested disclosure statement would share with an employer, and as the substrate for selective disclosure later. Free text and hashed when merklized: equality and set-membership queries only, and no on-chain policy is expected to query it.
